fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: IAM user ids that may read the row (server-stamped ACL).

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: ItemType
fields.description: Kind of shared item. One of: doc.file|doc.note|design.screen|attachment|wiki.page|change.request|change.attachment|release.preview|scope.

fields.name: TokenHash
fields.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the link token; the token itself is never stored. Unique index.

fields.name: ViewCount
fields.description: Number of times the public link was opened (default 0).

fields.name: LastViewedAt
fields.description: Time the public link was last opened.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
